description: This file defines a class TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner that inherits from TransactionTestRunnerBase. It includes methods for running recovery tests in a distributed Orleans cluster, handling transaction states, and verifying consistency after silo failures. It manages expected activity tracking, transaction execution, failure simulations, and result validation for testing transaction recovery scenarios.

classes.name: TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for executing transaction recovery tests within an Orleans testing cluster, managing transaction groups, simulating silo failures, and validating distributed transaction consistency.

classes.name: ExpectedGrainActivity
classes.description: A helper class representing expected and actual activity states of a grain involved in transactions, including methods to retrieve current state.

methods.name: TransactionRecoveryTestsRunner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the test runner with a test cluster and output handler.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp using testOutput and logger.

methods.name: TransactionWillRecoverAfterRandomSiloFailure
methods.description: Core method to test transaction recovery behavior after a simulated silo shutdown (graceful or ungraceful) and validate system recovery.

methods.name: WakeupGrains
methods.description: Activates a list of grains by pinging them.

methods.name: RunWhileSucceeding
methods.description: Runs transactions repeatedly until failure or a stop condition.

methods.name: CheckTxResult
methods.description: Verifies transaction results post-failure, asserting success if required.

methods.name: RunAllTxReportFailed
methods.description: Executes all transactions and reports which failed.

methods.name: AllTxSucceed
methods.description: Checks if all transactions in the group succeeded.

methods.name: SetBit
methods.description: Sets bits in grains within a transaction, handling exceptions and updating expected states.

methods.name: ValidateResults
methods.description: Validates the consistency of actual grain activity against expected outcomes after recovery.
